name: @allenai/design-system
description: DESIGN.md specs for Ai2's design system and the products that use it

scripts.compose:asta: bun run scripts/compose.ts --base strata/DESIGN.md --overlay asta/DESIGN.src.md --out asta/DESIGN.md
scripts.compose:olmo-earth: bun run scripts/compose.ts --base strata/DESIGN.md --overlay olmo-earth/DESIGN.src.md --out olmo-earth/DESIGN.md
scripts.compose: bun run compose:asta && bun run compose:olmo-earth
scripts.lint: npx @google/design.md lint strata/DESIGN.md && npx @google/design.md lint asta/DESIGN.md && npx @google/design.md lint olmo-earth/DESIGN.md && npx @google/design.md lint earthranger/DESIGN.md
scripts.tokens:strata: bun run scripts/emit-tokens.ts --spec strata/DESIGN.md --out strata/tokens.json --types strata/tokens.d.ts
scripts.tokens:asta: bun run scripts/emit-tokens.ts --spec asta/DESIGN.md --out asta/tokens.json --types asta/tokens.d.ts
scripts.tokens:olmo-earth: bun run scripts/emit-tokens.ts --spec olmo-earth/DESIGN.md --out olmo-earth/tokens.json --types olmo-earth/tokens.d.ts
scripts.tokens:earthranger: bun run scripts/emit-tokens.ts --spec earthranger/DESIGN.md --out earthranger/tokens.json --types earthranger/tokens.d.ts
scripts.tokens: bun run tokens:strata && bun run tokens:asta && bun run tokens:olmo-earth && bun run tokens:earthranger
scripts.build: bun run compose && bun run tokens && bun run dtcg
scripts.dtcg: bun run dtcg:strata && bun run dtcg:asta && bun run dtcg:olmo-earth && bun run dtcg:earthranger
